Updated for the 2 November 2026 game patch (game build 1283531): on the patched game 1.3.30 showed no Map Key & Filters panel, and the mod's map drawings, the Hollow Halls HD maps and G G's chest glow were missing or broken. This version needs the patched game.
Map Key with a controller: View on the World Map moves the controller into the Map Key & Filters panel (and Settings when it is open): the D-pad steps between its rows and buttons, A clicks, B goes back to the map. A strip under the panel shows these buttons, in all 15 languages. With Vanilla World Map on, View on the game's map brings the mod's map back. For Xbox-style pads (XInput, Steam Input's too).
Fixed: a controller switching off or being unplugged with the map open could crash the game. Pads are no longer read while Windows' device list is changing, Xbox and Steam Input pads are left to XInput, and a fault in the Windows joystick check turns it off for the session. Reported by microsoftenator.
Fixed: with a controller, the mod's keyboard hints at the bottom of the map all showed the A button; they're hidden while a controller is in use.
GGVeinOutlines=false under [General] in minimap_config.ini turns off G G's ore vein outlines; the chest glow stays.
